limitations: Additional feature connections add6240 decoder parameters; this is not capacity-independent proof. The same norm clipping rule acts on a larger parameter set.

Zero/shuffle feature controls are diagnostic interventions.

Machine-body error includes visible panel/lamp pixels; gradient error is full-frame adjacent differences, not texture-only or Laplacian. Individual run reports own their objective curves; aggregate training rows are explicitly arm-labelled to avoid combining curves.
Existing renderer, structural QA only.

final_evaluation.definitions:
Fixed evaluation scenes per population (kind-table textures): per-image records and means.

    Per image: MSE; PSNR = 10 log10(1/MSE); machine-body MSE over pixels of entities 1-2
    (None if the image has none); gradient error = 0.5 * (mean squared difference of the
    horizontal adjacent-pixel forward differences, recon vs target, + the same vertically).
    Scenes are drawn in chunks of DECODER_EVAL_CHUNK from Generator(seed); a final smaller
    chunk holds any remainder, and every chunk is hashed. Slots always come from the true
    pyramid. Interventions (diagnostic, not operational inference) replace only the
    decoder's pyramid values: `zero` = zeros; `shuffled` = image i reads image i-1's pyramid
    (roll by one over the whole population order).

Initial overbroad row-equality assertion failed solely on gradient norm: new parameters add gradient components; all forward metrics and input hashes exactly equal. Norms remain recorded, not required equal.

identity-compatibility-audit.json.scope: Fixed-policy source confirmation and four-scene R2 life only. Original full16-policy selection and six-population qualification remain historical source-bound evidence.

review_reconciliation: Shuffled features outperform zero, but that alone does not identify frame-independent learned content; zero changes feature statistics.
Additional parameters confound causal information-only claims; their optimization effect is not assumed favorable.
Codex selected actual decoder conditioning to honor the literal request; Alex confirmed the current-vs-modified decoder comparison, not an explicit rejection of a named alternative probe.
limits: Specific additive connections/budget/objective; no conclusion that features lack detail or optimization is saturated.
No adoption as default or memory/identity quality claim.
